name: dev.ucp.common.incentives.list
title: Incentives List
description: Lists the incentives a Business is currently offering in the request's context, without a product search or a session. Read-only: nothing is applied, and the Business remains authoritative on what applies to any cart or checkout.

incentives.description: Incentives the Business is offering in the resolved context. The response carries no nodes to target, so entries MUST NOT carry `applies_to`; an incentive limited to part of the assortment states that in `title` and `description`.

messages.description: Errors, warnings, or informational messages about the listed incentives.
